2026-10-10: fixes for the second independent S7 review (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s7-independent-rereview-20261010.md), commit f04a5d8c on work/phrf-s7-reconcile, not pushed.

1. Uncertain accounting. accounting.open (holding the run id) is written durably before any metered work. It is removed only by a successful final checkpoint, which runs on every exit of the invocation after all workers have stopped, with the interrupt flag cleared and restored. If the marker survives, the resume refuses with AccountingUncertain until an OwnerAccountingRecovery for that run id charges CPU; a wrong run id is refused. Tests: re-review 1a (unwritable cost.json) and 1b (mid-run disk snapshot).
2. A worker InterruptedException now has its child CPU metered and checkpointed before the run ends as Interrupted. Test: re-review 2 (guard 37, cost 37).
3. CpuGuard, OwnerCeilingRaise and OwnerAccountingRecovery are plain non-Serializable classes whose constructors re-validate, and the runner re-admits the guard. A raise names the one invocation it authorizes; it is recorded in cost.json, sealed as meta/ceiling-raise/<runId>, and logged with the run id and reason; reuse is refused. Tests: re-review 3, and the tiny-ceiling test.
4. Verifier: ImpossibleLedger and InconsistentInvocations. Test: re-review 4.
5. Aggregate D is bounded before narrowing and the unit count is compared in Long before allocation; a cost.json invocation count of Int.MaxValue is refused. Tests: re-review 5a and 5b.
6. OwnerCeilingRaise has no apply, copy or Mirror, and its constructor validates (60 < ceiling <= 240). Test: re-review 6 (compileErrors on Mirror, apply and new).

Each test fails with its fix reverted: one combined mutation run gave 7 of 8 failures, and 6 is compile-level.
Gates: JVM 507 total (497 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed); JS 246 passed; scalafimCompileAll exit 0 with 0 warnings. Synthetic only; a third independent review is pending.
